apks.help: Download ProjectHoneydew-*-quest.apk from the Project Honeydew site and pick the file.

inputs.label: Pikmin disc image (USA, Rev 1)
inputs.help: Your own Pikmin GameCube disc image, USA Rev 1, as a plain .iso or .gcm. Convert RVZ, WIA or GCZ images to ISO first, for example with Dolphin.

steps.text: Open Project Honeydew from Library > Unknown Sources, pick your disc image when asked and wait for the one-time import. Afterwards you can delete the image from Download. Uninstalling the app deletes its saves.

notes: APK only on projecthoneydew.com. A disc check (gamecube, revision 1) would help, but the guide does not give the game ID. The asset pattern ^ProjectHoneydew- does not match ProjectHoneydew2- files.
